title: Pre-registration, Amendment A: independent external validation of physics-informed augmentation for powder X-ray diffraction space-group classification
description:
Amendment A (Stage 2) of the pre-registration first archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.24208531 (Stage 1, 2026-11-13). Registered on 2026-11-20, before any model saw a measured pattern. It adds only the items §3 allows: the hashes of the unlabeled cohort manifest and the separately hashed label file, twin levels and clusters, the hashes of every new checkpoint with run logs, the code and mock-cohort analysis hashes, the environment lock and freezes, the scoring device, and the realized cohort size, label audit and power. The amended pre-registration (§12 deviations) is in preregistration/; the amendment is in preregistration/amendmentA/. Hashes only: data, labels, checkpoints and code are released with the journal paper. Sole author: Kishan Paschapur.

Licence scope: CC BY 4.0 applies to the pre-registration files (preregistration/), the README and this metadata only. paper.pdf is the author's version of the IEEE ONCON 2026 paper, copyright IEEE, and cv.pdf is the author's CV; neither is licensed under CC BY.
